Car2 can't move because both roads out of Shivapuri hospital are impassable, so car1 does all the rescuing from Galchhi shelter. It makes five round trips of four passengers each. Two adults at Kalika farm and the injured person at Thakre care home are deferred.

**Trip costs:**
- **Belkot farm** (4 elderly): Galchhi–Belkot and back, 23 × 2 = **46 min**.
- **Likhu care home** (3 elderly + 1 injured): via Belkot and Kalika, (23 + 9 + 20) × 2 = **104 min**.
- **Naukunda and Gosaikunda, first trip** (1 Naukunda elderly + 1 Gosaikunda elderly + 2 adults): via Naukunda, (10 + 12) × 2 = **44 min**.
- **Gosaikunda, second trip** (4 children): same route, **44 min**.
- **Kalika farm** (4 of the 6 adults): via Belkot, (23 + 9) × 2 = **64 min**.

**Why defer:**
- **Remaining 2 Kalika adults:** another trip would cost 64 min, more than their 40 penalty.
- **Thakre injured person:**
  - A dedicated trip would cost 140 min, more than the 80 penalty.
  - Swapping them into the Likhu trip would add 36 min and defer an elderly person (50), totalling 86. That is also more than 80.

**Total:** driving 46 + 104 + 44 + 44 + 64 = 302 min, plus penalties 40 + 80 = 120, gives **422**.
